hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 scripts/check_all.py --quiet 2>/dev/null; if python3 -c 'import pytest' 2>/dev/null; then echo "[unit tests] $(python3 -m pytest 2>&1 | grep -aE '[0-9]+ (passed|failed|error)' | tail -1)"; else echo '[unit tests] pytest not installed — run: make test-units'; fi; true
